meta.title: Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Verify that Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks are absent or unavailable on a Growth-plan tenant.
Attempt vendor onboarding with an email domain belonging to a group entity and a PAN belonging to a group entity, and observe the Growth-plan block.
Repeat the same onboarding attempts on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that the capability is available and works.
Compare the same Compliance Officer workflow across Growth and Enterprise tenants.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks are absent or unavailable on a Growth-plan tenant.; Attempt vendor onboarding with an email domain belonging to a group entity and a PAN belonging to a group entity, and observe the Growth-plan block.; Repeat the same onboarding attempts on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that the capability is available and works.; Compare the same Compliance Officer workflow across Growth and Enterprise tenants.

args.need: sign in as the Compliance Officer, test vendor onboarding with group-entity email-domain and PAN conflicts on both Growth and Enterprise tenants, and report whether the hard-block capability is absent or refused on Growth and available on Enterprise

steps.note: No catalog step can access vendor onboarding, inspect plan-gated Conflict-of-Interest Hard Blocks, or perform the required cross-tenant comparison.
Confirm the session remains usable after the tester completes or skips the unavailable workflow; this does not assert the plan-specific behavior.
